title: Brown Sugar Bubble Tea with Tapioca Pearls
summary: Strong chilled black tea and cold milk over chewy tapioca pearls soaked in brown sugar syrup, served iced with wide straws.

ingredients.item: strong black tea bags (Assam or breakfast tea)

steps.title: Brew the tea
steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the freshly boiled water for 10 minutes for a strong brew. Squeeze them out, cool the tea, then chill it. You need about 360 ml.

steps.title: Make the syrup
steps.text: Boil the brown sugar and water in a small pan, stirring, then simmer for 3 minutes until slightly thickened. Take off the heat.

steps.title: Cook the pearls
steps.text: Drop the pearls into plenty of boiling water and stir so they don't stick. Cook as the packet says, usually 5 minutes, then cover and rest for 2-3 minutes until chewy right through. Lift them out with a slotted spoon straight into the warm syrup and stir.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Leave the pearls in the syrup at room temperature for 20-30 minutes so they turn glossy and sweet. Use them within 4 hours; chilling makes them hard.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Divide the pearls and syrup between the glasses, add ice, then pour in the cold tea and milk. Stir well and serve with wide straws.

tips: Taste a pearl before draining: it should be soft with only a slight bounce in the centre.
For tiger stripes, tilt the glass and drizzle a little syrup down the inside before adding the pearls.
safety: Oat or soya milk works; check the label for allergens.
storage: The tea keeps in the fridge for up to 4 days. Make the pearls fresh and use within 4 hours. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
